values.视频提示词:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the late-night study environment as a whole, including the dark wooden desk, the silver laptop with its cool-white glowing screen, the warm desk lamp, the rows of bookshelves on the right, and the rain-soaked window glass, in a Chinese-animation CG style.
<Picture 1> is the first frame of [Shot 1], establishing the wide composition of the study: the dark wooden desk sits left of centre, the silver laptop with its cool-white glowing screen and the warm desk lamp are on the desk, rows of bookshelves stand on the right, and rain-soaked window glass forms the background.
<Picture 2> is the keyframe of [Shot 2], establishing the close-up composition of the window glass: the metal window frame, the window sill, and the rain marks and light reflections on the glass surface.
<Picture 3> is the first frame of [Shot 3], establishing the wide composition of the study at the endpoint of the pull-back, with the relative positions of the furniture and the bookshelves exactly the same as in <Picture 1>.

summary:
[keyframe completion] The target video is a fifteen-second empty shot of the late-night study: the camera pushes in at a steady rate from the wide view of <Picture 1>, passes exactly through the window-glass close-up of <Picture 2> at 7.50 seconds, then pulls back at a steady rate and lands on the wide composition of <Picture 3> at 15.04 seconds, in one continuous single shot with no cuts throughout.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the furniture, the bookshelves, the lighting, and the rainy night outside the window of the study stay exactly consistent across the three anchors, and only the camera distance changes over the whole video.
<Picture 1> ([Shot 1] first frame): fully_preserved - the video starts exactly from the composition, lighting, and spatial relationships of <Picture 1>.
<Picture 2> ([Shot 2] keyframe): fully_preserved - the push-in passes exactly through the window-glass close-up composition of <Picture 2> at 7.50 seconds.
<Picture 3> ([Shot 3] first frame): fully_preserved - the pull-back lands exactly on the wide composition of <Picture 3> at 15.04 seconds.

detailed_description:
The target video is a Chinese-animation CG style late-night empty shot of the study, held at a fixed eye-level camera height throughout.
[Shot 1] The video starts from <Picture 1>. <Subject 1> is presented from an eye-level camera position, the dark wooden desk sits left of centre, the silver laptop with its cool-white glowing screen and the warm desk lamp on the desk form the main light area, rows of bookshelves are arranged along the depth on the right, and rain-soaked window glass forms the background. From 0.00 seconds the camera pushes forward at a slow, steady rate, and the frame closes in continuously from the wide view of the study; the warm lamp light forms a contrast with the cool light of the rainy night outside the window, the reflections and rain marks on the glass surface gradually become clearer, and the push-in runs steadily and continuously with no pause.
[Shot 2] At 00:07.500, the push-in reaches the window-glass close-up established by <Picture 2>; the metal window frame and the window sill enter the frame, the rain marks, the water streaks, and the reflections of the indoor lights on the glass are clearly discernible, and raindrops slide slowly down the glass.
[Shot 3] At 00:15.042, the camera pulls back continuously from the window-glass close-up, and the pull-back rate is slow and even; the metal window frame and the window sill leave the frame first, then the full view of the study returns to the frame, the relative positions of the furniture and the bookshelves stay unchanged, the silver laptop with its cool-white glowing screen at the centre of the desk stays lit and in place throughout, and the shot finally lands on the pull-back endpoint composition established by <Picture 3>.

overall_soundscape:
Continuous moderate rain and the sound of raindrops on the glass run through the whole video, the inside of the study is quiet, and there are only the faint rustle of a pen tip across paper and the occasional sound of a page turning.

non_diegetic_music:
A low, restrained sustained single cello note at a very light volume, fading out slowly with the pull-back after 12.00 seconds.

## 0043_关键帧视频 (MiniMax H3 关键帧锚定)

- **首帧、尾帧位置固定**: 第 1 槽 `<Picture 1> 首帧` 恒钉视频第 0 帧, 第 9 槽 `<Picture 9> 尾帧` 恒钉视频末帧, 两者都**不需要秒数列**
- 首帧由 `#40` 的 `frame_idx` 控件硬钉 `0`; 尾帧由 `#37` 表达式 `max(0, b - 1)` (b = length) 钉到末帧
- **中间帧看秒数**: 第 2~8 槽每列 `<Picture n>` 右侧紧跟 `关键帧n所在秒数(FLOAT)`, 该秒数经连线换算成帧索引钉住这张图
- 中间帧定位公式: 帧索引 = `max(0, min(round(秒数 x 24), 视频帧数 - 1))` (秒数留空按 0 处理)
- `<Picture n>` 留空 = 该槽不锚定 (FallingTSH3AddGuide 空输入原样透传), 留空安全, 不会报错
- 中间帧算出的帧与已锚定的帧撞帧时, 该节点撤掉本次图片锚点并告警 (同帧只保留先到的一个)
- 「锚点数」列 = 本行实际填写的图片列数, 供提示词书写参考, 不参与定位
- 提示词里的 `<Picture N>` 编号 = 该图在**非空图片里的排位** (H3 逐张累加, 空槽跳过): 首帧 = `<Picture 1>`, 第 i 个中间帧 = `<Picture i+1>`, **尾帧 = `<Picture 锚点数>`** —— 尾帧虽固定在第 9 槽, 提示词里写的是它的排位号
- 每列同时进 ref_images(文本编码器可见) 与引导节点(锚定帧构图)
- 权重: ref2va + ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1; 采样 euler+simple 4 步; shift 6/3; Sage 加速
- 帧数 length = 视频秒数x24 向上吸附 17k+5 网格 (15 秒 = 362 帧); 尾帧 = 第 361 帧 = 15.042 秒
- 切换: FallingTSSwitch — True=4步 (上方采样参数: turbo LoRA + euler + shift 6/3)
                          False=20步 (无 LoRA + res_multistep + simple + 模型默认 shift, 不经 SigmaShift)
- 缓存: EasyCache (0.2/0.15/0.7) 仅挂 20步分支; 4步分支只用 LoRA, 不经过缓存
